# CP5 extension: alert hours around events (generated by `airalerts/events.py`)

Events: `data/events/events.csv` (47 dated events, committed before the analysis).
Window [-1, +3] days around each event; local placebo permutation: each date
moved by a random 5..30 days (either side), 10000 times.
excess_h = mean hours/day in event windows minus the placebo mean; CI from the placebo distribution;
p_more = P(placebo >= observed), p_less = P(placebo <= observed). No correction for the
15 tests is applied in the table - with 15 tests one p < 0.05 is expected by chance.
